tables.name: Bratislor Naming Method
tables.description: Which naming method a Bratislor settlement name uses. Each result is a naming method; its faces are its weight (starter weights 70% / 30%). Sombre old-settlement style; a fictional, language-inspired set, not a claim of accurate Slavic morphology.

results.name: Geographic Compound
results.description: First element + second element as one word, e.g. Drevgrad, Morava, Vranova.

results.name: Historical Founder
results.description: A founder's name joined directly to a settlement element, without an English possessive, e.g. Vorelgrad, Radanov.
